Neatly arranged perfectly front-facing flat lay, level waistband, centered fly, legs straight nearly parallel with a small natural gap, both hems level. Reduce large storage wrinkles, retain natural denim texture and wash variation. No creases ironed down center. Remove all blue/cyan cutout edge artifacts.
